diego_p: Quick question - I moved states between offer acceptance and start date. My payroll direct deposit is set up but my state tax withholding looks like the old state. Do I need to resubmit a new W-4/State form?
people-ops: Hey Diego, yes you'll need to complete the state withholding form (varies by state). For most states we have a fillable PDF in Casebook under Onboarding > Tax Forms. Upload the completed form and we can update payroll retroactively to your start date if you provide the move effective date.
diego_p: Cool. Also curious about benefits effective date since I changed my personal address to the new state - any impact?
people-ops: For medical/dental there's no change in effective date due to state change; network coverage might vary (in-network providers differ by state). If your plan has different provider networks, benefits-bot will show the network for your new state and you may see different copays/out-of-network rules.
jessie.payroll: Note: state tax changes will show on the next payrun after processing. If the new state withholding should apply retroactively we'll adjust and issue a catch-up in the next payrun with line `STATE_ADJ`.
diego_p: Thanks, submitting the form now. Appreciate it.
